title: One-Hot Set of Data
body:
The design matrix below was used to fit an OLS model with an intercept and one categorical feature. The categorical feature has been one-hot encoded.

Note: Assume that the categorical feature has no missing values and that no categories have been combined.

The design matrix has $$6$$ columns: $$	ext{col\_0}$$ (all 1s, the intercept), and $$	ext{col\_1}$$ through $$	ext{col\_5}$$ (one-hot encoded columns). There are $$7$$ rows (indices $$0-6)$$. Rows $$0-4$$ each have exactly one of $$	ext{col\_1}$$ through $$	ext{col\_5}$$ equal to $$1$$, and rows $$5$$ and $$6$$ have all of $$	ext{col\_1}$$ through $$	ext{col\_5}$$ equal to 0.
